findings.summary: Round 1 high finding resolved on two levels. (1) src/api/httpClient.ts readErrorDetails now folds extra error keys (pendingBlocks) into ApiError.details, so readPendingBlocks reads the server 422 directly. (2) diagnosesApi.completeDiagnosis keeps a defensive fallback: on 422 incomplete without a block list it GETs the draft and runs the shared pendingBlocks() the server uses. Dev probe 3/3 pass. The QA round-1 probe (phase-1-frontend-questionnaire-qa/questionnaire-r1.probe.test.ts) passes 5/6: in the 'R1 server shape' case readPendingBlocks returns the right blocks, but its call-sequence assertion expects an extra GET that no longer happens because httpClient now keeps the list. That assertion is obsolete; the visible behavior is correct.

Upstream 415 json_required on body-less POSTs (start/complete) is fixed in the shared client: request() now sets Content-Type application/json for every method in JSON_WRITE_METHODS. diagnosesApi start/complete go through that client unchanged; requireJsonWrites stays in place.
The discard dialog shows Diagnosis.createdAt (sent by the server) and falls back to the last save time only when createdAt is missing (QuestionnairePage.tsx:172).

No runtime walkthrough in a browser (answer, reload #/diagnostico/:id, 'Salvo automaticamente às HH:MM', pending alert, gold gate confirm/cancel, discard confirm/cancel). It needs a running server and browser, and the single-session rule forbids a detached server here. tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts and tests/e2e/calculator.spec.ts belong to integration.

evidence.command: npx vitest run --config <dev temp dir>/vitest.probe.config.ts (dev probe + QA r1 probe)
evidence.result: 8 passed, 1 failed: the only failure is the obsolete call-sequence assertion in the QA probe ('R1 server shape' expects an extra GET); readPendingBlocks returns the expected blocks there. Dev probe pending.probe.test.ts 3/3 pass. Round-1 probe-before (exit 1) and probe-after (exit 0) logs are kept in the same directory.

src/features/diagnosis/* make no direct fetch or /api/ calls; every call goes through diagnosesApi (POST /api/companies/:id/diagnoses, GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/diagnoses/:id, POST /api/diagnoses/:id/complete) with the IF-003 fields.

messages.text: AC-dm-14: httpClient readErrorDetails now carries the 422 error.pendingBlocks in ApiError.details, so the client reads the list directly. diagnosesApi keeps a fallback GET plus the shared pendingBlocks() only for the case where the list is missing. The QA round-1 probe assertion that expects that extra GET is obsolete; the blocks it checks are correct.

Still to run (needs server + browser): pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts tests/e2e/calculator.spec.ts. Check: answer a question, reload #/diagnostico/:id and see the same answers plus 'Salvo automaticamente às HH:MM'; 'Ver meu resultado' with gaps shows role=alert with links ?bloco=N; with everything answered the gold 'Concluir o diagnóstico?' opens, and Cancelar keeps the draft; 'Descartar rascunho' confirm/cancel shows the createdAt date.
